Rank per GPU model

Rank is among tracked vendors with a comparable rate for the same published GPU name: a single-GPU, headline-eligible, non-reserved, non-serverless, non-interruptible offer. Lower hourly equivalent wins. Affiliate status is not a ranking factor. Multi-GPU, serverless, reserved, or interruptible offers are listed but not given a rank in this table, with the reason shown. If the feed has no hourly figure, it is listed as no figure recorded; none is invented.

Undercut in the last 14 days

History is incomplete for this window. No daily snapshot was published for 2026-11-07, 2026-11-08. Undercut counts use only the 12 snapshot days that exist (2026-10-29 … 2026-11-11). No snapshot exists for those days, so undercut counts do not include them and do not assume prices held steady. No figures were invented for those days.

An undercut observation is one snapshot day and GPU name where this vendor had a comparable ranked 1-GPU, non-spot, non-reserved rate and at least one other tracked vendor was strictly cheaper the same day. Counts are observations, not distinct hours. Days with no comparable ranked rate for this vendor are not counted as undercuts.
